tagline: The questionable logic of ordinary life, deconstructed.
subject: Amit Tandon

currentShow.title: Aise Kaise
currentShow.theme: Changing times, domestic rituals, and the questionable logic behind how friends, family, and Amit himself behave.

gyanBites.quote: My wife said we need to talk. Which means she will talk, and I will nod at calculated intervals.
Middle-class upgrade rule: You know you have arrived in life when you stop opening the car window for toll tickets.
gyanBites.context: Paisa Aa Gaya... Class Nahi Aayi!

gyanBites.quote: In India, parents don't ask you what you want to become. They tell you the two engineering colleges you are applying to.
Aise Kaise?! You bought a 4K OLED TV to watch 360p WhatsApp forwards at full volume.

corporate.title: Corporate Keynotes & Private Galas
corporate.bio: An engineering graduate with an MBA from IIT Delhi and a decade of corporate entrepreneurship running recruitment enterprises, Amit Tandon bridges boardroom wit with relatable storytelling.
bullets: Customized sets for leadership retreats, global CXO summits, and annual galas

about.short: Observational Hindi stand-up comedian known for clean, universal humor deconstructing marriage, parenting, middle-class upgrades, and human contradictions.
about.journeyLine: Mechanical Engineer → IIT Delhi MBA → Corporate Entrepreneur → Global Touring Comedian.
